title: allow shell variables or give reviewers a grep of a fixed file path without a var

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261120-014727-adb2, project ork, item S307:

allow shell variables or give reviewers a grep of a fixed file path without a var

Evidence: Bash with F=path; grep ... $F was denied: "A variable in this command can't be checked before it runs"
